display.label: AWS EC2 Instance
display.description: Provision scalable Amazon EC2 virtual machines with storage, networking, and security configurations

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique name and identifier for the EC2 instance, applied as the 'Name' tag.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core instance settings including compute size, AMI, and placement.

fields.label: Instance Name
fields.description: Name applied to the instance as a tag and identifier.

fields.label: Instance Type
fields.description: EC2 instance size and family (e.g. t3.micro, m5.large, c6i.xlarge).

fields.label: AMI ID
fields.description: Amazon Machine Image ID. Leave empty to automatically use latest Amazon Linux 2023.

fields.label: Key Pair Name
fields.description: Name of the EC2 Key Pair for SSH/RDP access.

fields.label: Availability Zone
fields.description: Specific AZ to launch the instance into (e.g. us-east-1a). Optional.

fields.label: Tenancy
fields.description: Hardware tenancy of the instance.

sections.label: Network & Interfaces
sections.description: VPC subnet, security groups, and IP address allocation.

fields.label: Subnet ID
fields.description: VPC Subnet ID where the instance primary interface will reside.

fields.label: Security Group IDs
fields.description: List of VPC Security Group IDs to associate with the instance.

fields.label: Auto-assign Public IP
fields.description: Whether to request a public IPv4 address from the subnet pool.

fields.label: Static Private IP
fields.description: Specific private IPv4 address to assign within the subnet.

fields.label: Secondary Private IPs
fields.description: Additional private IPv4 addresses to associate with the primary interface.

fields.label: Allocate Elastic IP (EIP)
fields.description: Allocate and associate a dedicated static Elastic IP to this instance.

fields.label: Source / Destination Check
fields.description: Enable source/destination IP checking. Disable for NAT gateways or firewall appliances.

sections.label: Storage Configuration
sections.description: Root volume parameters and additional EBS volume attachments.

fields.label: Root Block Device
fields.description: Parameters for the primary root EBS volume.

fields.label: KMS Key ID / ARN
fields.description: Custom KMS key for encryption. Leave blank for default AWS managed key.

fields.label: Additional EBS Volumes
fields.description: List of secondary EBS disks to attach to the instance.

fields.label: Device Name
fields.description: Block device name (e.g. /dev/sdf, /dev/xvdf).

sections.label: Security & IAM
sections.description: IAM instance role and Instance Metadata Service (IMDSv2) hardening.

fields.label: IAM Instance Profile
fields.description: IAM Instance Profile name or ARN to grant AWS API permissions to the VM.

fields.label: Metadata Options (IMDSv2)
fields.description: Configure IMDSv2 tokens and security hop limit.

fields.label: IMDSv2 Tokens
fields.description: Required enforces IMDSv2 token usage for enhanced security.

sections.label: Protection & Management
sections.description: Lifecycle protection, monitoring, CPU credits, and bootstrap scripts.

fields.label: Termination Protection
fields.description: Protect the instance from accidental termination.

fields.label: Stop Protection
fields.description: Protect the instance from accidental stop requests.

fields.label: Detailed Monitoring
fields.description: Enable detailed 1-minute CloudWatch metric collection (extra AWS charges apply).

fields.label: EBS Optimized
fields.description: Dedicated throughput between Amazon EC2 and Amazon EBS.

fields.label: T-series CPU Credits
fields.description: Credit option for burstable instance families.

fields.label: User Data Script
fields.description: Shell script or cloud-init directives executed at first boot.

fields.label: Recreate on User Data Change
fields.description: Force instance destroy and recreate if user data changes.

fields.label: Instance Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags applied to the EC2 instance.

fields.label: Volume Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags applied to all attached EBS storage volumes.
